string.name: auth_live_hotp_counter_notice
string.value: HOTP is counter-based. Set this to the service’s current counter. Moving backward or skipping values can desynchronize the account.

string.name: auth_live_hotp_parameters_notice
string.value: HOTP is not time-based. Use the service’s exact HMAC algorithm and code length. The counter changes only after a successful saved advance.

string.name: auth_live_hotp_next_accessibility
string.value: Generate next HOTP code for %s, %s. Current counter %s.

string.name: auth_live_invalid_uri_v2
string.value: This is not a valid authenticator setup QR code (otpauth://totp or otpauth://hotp).

string.name: auth_live_invalid_parameters_v2
string.value: Check the algorithm, code length, TOTP period or HOTP counter. HOTP counters must be non-negative safe integers. Steam uses SHA1 / 5 characters / 30 seconds. Limit: 500 accounts.

string.name: auth_live_unsupported_import_v2
string.value: This import format is not supported yet. Use a single standard TOTP or HOTP setup QR code. Google Authenticator migration QR codes are not supported.

string.name: auth_live_privacy_body_v2
string.value:
Authenticator service names, accounts, setup keys and parameters are stored in an encrypted ArkData database on this device. Database encryption keys are managed by the system. TimeAuth does not upload these records to its own server or download service icons.

App unlock is off by default and can be enabled in Settings. When enabled, system identity verification gates access; TimeAuth does not receive your device password or biometric templates. Whether App unlock is enabled or not, backgrounding closes the active authenticator session and releases decoded credentials and generated codes; when App unlock is off, returning to the foreground reopens the session automatically. JavaScript memory cannot be guaranteed to be physically erased.

TOTP and Steam codes are time-based. HOTP is counter-based: copying the current code never advances it, and the counter is incremented only when you explicitly request the next code and that update is saved successfully. Scanning uses the system Scan Kit interface and its camera/gallery controls; supported TOTP or HOTP QR codes are reviewed before you save them. Tapping a code writes it to the system clipboard; automatic clearing follows your settings.

Backup, export, cloud sync and Google Authenticator batch migration are not implemented. Uninstalling, clearing app data or losing the device may lose keys. Keep service recovery codes. Password Vault remains a separate preview; password generation and authenticators are real features.

string.name: auth_live_invalid_secret_v2
string.value: Invalid setup key. Check the selected Base32/Base64 format. TOTP and HOTP keys must contain 10–512 bytes; Steam requires exactly 20 bytes.

string.name: auth_live_crypto_error_v2
string.value: Unable to generate a code. Affected codes are hidden. Retry; your saved accounts and HOTP counters have not been removed.

string.name: auth_live_onboarding_local_v2
string.value: Authenticator keys and HOTP counters are stored in an encrypted local database. TOTP/Steam codes use the device clock; HOTP uses its saved counter.
